column3: The sidebar renders the home snapshot whole: its Projects and Threads lists drop the first-load stagger (im-rise started every row at opacity 0, so a load caught in its first ~300 ms showed 1 of 3 projects); the Threads list follows the project the address names, else a Captain's own project, else the first live one, so #/c/<alias> and #/settings no longer say 'Open a project to see its threads'; and the empty-state copy waits for the first home snapshot
column4: XIN-33 live run: the sidebar loaded partially and differently on each load. The XIN-33 screenshot keeps the full three-row height with rows 2 and 3 blank and row 1 offset by 3 px, which is the stagger in flight. The server's home snapshot always carried all three projects. routeProject() resolves only #/ and #/p/<slug>, by construction
column5: web/e2e/sidebar-race.test.ts loads #/, #/c/bosun, #/settings/general and #/p/gamma 24 times each over a fake socket, with randomized 0-150 ms snapshot and route delays. With the stagger back, all 4 tests fail (opacities 0.34/0/0); with routeProject back, #/c/bosun and #/settings fail; with the empty copy ungated, all 4 fail
